Bún Chả in Hanoi – An Unforgettable Culinary Experience
Oct 2026 • Friends
On our last day in Hanoi, we wanted to enjoy bún chả once again, having first discovered and fallen in love with this traditional Vietnamese dish during one of our excursions. We turned to ChatGPT for a recommendation, and that is how we found this wonderful restaurant!

Our journey there was a little mysterious. Walking through the Old Quarter, we made our way along narrow, dark and rather deserted alleys, wondering what we would find at the end. When we finally arrived, the restaurant itself gave us no particular reason to expect anything extraordinary. It looked quite ordinary, both from the outside and inside, and I honestly wondered why so many people described it as a hidden gem in Hanoi.

Then the food arrived.

With the very first dishes, we understood everything. The flavours were absolutely extraordinary — not merely delicious, but on another level entirely. Every mouthful was a delight, and we kept wanting more and more, until we simply could not eat another bite!

It was a perfect reminder that you should never judge a restaurant by its appearance. Sometimes, the most unassuming places offer the most remarkable culinary experiences.

The taste of this bún chả is something I will remember for a very long time. If you visit Hanoi and want to discover authentic Vietnamese flavours, I wholeheartedly recommend giving this place a try.

An unforgettable meal, extraordinary flavours and a true hidden gem. Thank you, ChatGPT, for leading us to this little treasure in Hanoi!

The best Bún Chả in Hanoi: Michelin star and quality absolutely deserved!
Aug 2026 • Couples
If you want to taste an authentic Bún Chả in Hanoi, this place at number 21 Nguyễn Hữu Huân is an absolutely mandatory stop. Everything was simply "top" from the first to the last minute!
The recognition in the Michelin Guide is totally deserved: the grilled meat is tender, flavorful, and has that fantastic, perfect smokiness, immersed in a delicious warm broth that is perfectly balanced between sweet and savory. The portions are generous, accompanied by very fresh rice noodles, an abundance of aromatic herbs, and crispy, delicious nem (fried spring rolls), including seafood and vegetarian ones.
The environment is welcoming, clean, and well-organized over several floors, while the staff proved to be very fast, kind, and always ready to explain how to best enjoy the dish.
Excellent value for money for a gastronomic experience of this level in the heart of the Old Quarter. Highly recommended with all my heart!
